items.statement: An autonomous investigation defines and documents a finite candidate-generation and deduplication rule for Na/vacancy orderings.
items.expected: The report gives per-composition generation coverage, stable IDs, and a reproducible deduplication rule.

items.statement: Candidate energies and structures are validated before hull interpretation.
items.expected: Convergence/status and at least one numerical or structural cross-check are tied to individual candidates or composition records.

items.statement: The energy data support a convex-hull phase-stability analysis across the sodium-content range.
items.expected: The final hull includes the source-supported stable endpoint/intermediate states and reports composition-specific membership.

items.statement: Stable-phase energy differences yield a multistep sodium insertion voltage profile.
items.expected: Voltage records cover each adjacent stable phase pair and state the bulk-sodium reference and units.

items.statement: Relaxed endpoint structures permit a quantitative volume-change assessment.
items.expected: The report provides both endpoint volumes, signed percent change and a limitation-aware low-strain interpretation.
